headline: 28,652 Pass August–September 2026 Nurses Licensure Examination
seoTitle: 28,652 Pass August–September 2026 Nurses Licensure Exam | FMB News
seoDescription: The Professional Regulation Commission says 28,652 of 37,359 examinees passed the August–September 2026 Nurses Licensure Examination, a 76.69% passing rate.
deck: PRC says 28,652 of 37,359 examinees passed, while the results of 21 examinees were withheld pending final determination under licensure-examination rules.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Professional Regulation Commission announced that 28,652 of 37,359 examinees passed the Nurses Licensure Examination administered in August and September 2026, equivalent to a 76.69% passing rate.
GMA News independently reported the results early Saturday, September 19, citing PRC.

sections.heading: What is confirmed
paragraphs: PRC's released results state that 28,652 examinees passed. The results of 21 examinees were withheld pending final determination of their liabilities under the rules and regulations governing licensure examinations.
A University of Northern Philippines–Vigan graduate obtained the highest score, according to the PRC results reported by GMA News.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The examinations were administered by the Board of Nursing across 26 testing centers nationwide. The released figures place the passing rate at 76.69%.

sections.heading: What remains unresolved
paragraphs: PRC has not announced the final disposition of the 21 withheld examination results. FMB News is not characterizing those examinees as having committed violations because the Commission says their cases remain pending final determination.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: PRC says online registration for Professional Identification Cards and Certificates of Registration will begin October 13, 2026. Successful examinees must personally register and sign the Roster of Registered Professionals. The date and venue of the oathtaking ceremony will be announced separately.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The examination determines entry into the regulated nursing profession for tens of thousands of candidates and adds a large new cohort of qualified nurses to the Philippine health workforce.

sources.title: University of Northern Philippines-Vigan grad tops August, September 2026 Philippine nurses licensure exam

verificationNotes: GMA News reported the PRC results at 1:06 a.m. PHT on September 19, including the total examinees, passers, withheld results and registration date.
Independent exam-results reporting reproduces the PRC announcement that 28,652 of 37,359 examinees passed, a 76.69% passing rate.
The 21 withheld results are described as pending final determination; the article does not infer misconduct or guilt.
